pred_sql:
SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools c ON s.cds = c.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND c.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, t.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores T1
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0 AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS FirstName, s.AdmLName1 AS LastName
FROM schools s
WHERE s.CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2
FROM schools s
WHERE s.CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM schools s
WHERE s.CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.School, t.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT School FROM (
  SELECT s.School, s.County,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rk <= 5

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  )
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS pct
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9' AND s.County = 'Los Angeles'
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
  AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS percent_eligible_free, f.`District Code`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT *
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY school_count DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.uuid
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND c.borderColor = 'white'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT DISTINCT c.subtypes, c.supertypes
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE f.language = 'German'
  AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND c.supertypes IS NOT NULL

SELECT id,
       (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(id) FROM cards) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 0
ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*') AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%'

SELECT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ravnica' AND s.baseSetSize = 180

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

SELECT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND s.code = 'ARC'

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')

LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code)
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND t.language = 'Italian'
  AND t.translation IS NOT NULL

    SELECT 1
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
    JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
      AND st.language = 'Korean'

SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE baseSetSize < 10 AND code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Italian' AND translation IS NOT NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code
WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5
  AND (T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL)

SELECT fd.name
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1 AND l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = (
    SELECT format
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
WHERE s.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean')
  AND s.code NOT IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%' AND setCode IS NOT NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian'

SELECT AVG(p.Score)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025

SELECT CASE WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' ELSE 'well-finished' END AS result
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 23853 AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON u.Id = v.UserId
WHERE v.Id = 6347

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5

SELECT c.frameVersion, c.name,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalities l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status = 'Banned') THEN 'Banned' ELSE 'Not banned' END AS banned_status
FROM cards c
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17
SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5
)

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT AVG(UpVotes) AS avg_upvotes, AVG(Age) AS avg_age
FROM users
WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM votes

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
     - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS diff
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT u.Id
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId)

SELECT p.Tags
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p.CommentCount = 0
  AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(p.ViewCount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS diff
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate)
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON u.Id = v.UserId
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(pl.Id) AS REAL) / 12
FROM postLinks pl
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE p.AnswerCount <= 2
  AND strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT u.Id
  FROM users u
  JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
  GROUP BY u.Id
  HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
)

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011'

SELECT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.CommentCount = 1 AND c.Score = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(Currency = 'EUR') AS REAL) / SUM(Currency = 'CZK') AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
ORDER BY T2.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date,5,2) AS month
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY y.Date
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Segment,
       100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END)
              - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END))
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END) AS pct_increase
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

SELECT 
  CASE WHEN SUM(Currency='CZK') > SUM(Currency='EUR') THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS MoreCZK,
  SUM(Currency='CZK') - SUM(Currency='EUR') AS Difference
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2013-06%'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date,1,4)='2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date,1,4)='2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date,1,4)='2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date='2012-08-25' AND Price=634.8
)

SELECT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON l.id = m.league_id
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY CAST(SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal)

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE substr(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011'

SELECT SUM(pa.overall_rating) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.id) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) <= '2015'

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo')
  -
  (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS difference

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
  AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p

c AS (
  SELECT substr(time,1,1)*3600 + substr(time,3,2)*60 + substr(time,6) AS secs
  FROM r WHERE positionOrder=1
),
l AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN instr(time,':')>0
           THEN substr(time,2,instr(time,':')-2)*60 + substr(time,instr(time,':')+1)
           ELSE substr(time,2) END AS inc
  FROM r ORDER BY positionOrder DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (l.inc - c.secs) * 100.0 / (l.inc + c.secs) AS pct
FROM c, l

JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters'
  AND ev.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT b.category, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category

SELECT m.last_name, ma.department, ma.college
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT b.category
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND date(event_date) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
  AND s.height_cm > 200

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue' AND sp.power_name = 'Agility'

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id
JOIN colour h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id
WHERE e.colour = 'Blue' AND h.colour = 'Blond'

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       s.height_cm,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Gold' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute ha2
    JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  )

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       c.colour,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.eye_colour_id) AS colour_count,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.eye_colour_id) DESC) AS popularity_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY colour_count DESC, c.colour, s.superhero_name

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND ha.attribute_value < 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch'

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics'
    WHEN SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') < SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'DC Comics'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS more_published,
  ABS(SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
LIMIT 5

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero)

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id)
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Stealth'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ce.colour AS eye_colour, ch.colour AS hair_colour, cs.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN colour ce ON s.eye_colour_id = ce.id
LEFT JOIN colour ch ON s.hair_colour_id = ch.id
LEFT JOIN colour cs ON s.skin_colour_id = cs.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id
JOIN colour h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id
WHERE e.colour = 'Black' AND h.colour = 'Black'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN full_name = 'Emil Blonsky' THEN weight_kg END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN full_name = 'Charles Chandler' THEN weight_kg END) AS difference
FROM superhero
SELECT CAST(SUM(height_cm) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND a.alignment = 'Bad'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name ASC

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics'
        ELSE 'Marvel Comics'
    END AS more_publisher,
    ABS(SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS difference
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id

SELECT DISTINCT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT P.Diagnosis, L.Date
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 30609

SELECT
  CASE WHEN SUM(Admission='+') > SUM(Admission='-') THEN 'in-patient' ELSE 'outpatient' END AS more,
  100.0 * (SUM(Admission='+') - SUM(Admission='-')) / SUM(Admission='-') AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 1
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'

SELECT E.Symptoms, P.Diagnosis
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18

SELECT L.Date, CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.ID = (
  SELECT ID FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND Birthday IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY Birthday ASC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination)

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT > 60
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS IDs
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory L WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0)
GROUP BY P.SEX

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) > 50

SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CPK >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis, CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC < 3.5

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10 AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) > 55

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGA > 80 AND l.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND P.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND L.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND P.SEX = 'M'

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM (
    SELECT P.Diagnosis, COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS cnt
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400
    GROUP BY P.Diagnosis
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND E.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+')

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+'

SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'o') AS cnt
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-')
)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.atom_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT printf('%.5f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(bond_id)) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008'

SELECT printf('%.4f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom_id)) AS percent
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element IN ('i','s')
  AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-')

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = ' = '
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id

SELECT CAST(COUNT(c.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_bonds
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i'

SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
UNION
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
  SELECT atom_id FROM connected
  UNION
  SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
)

SELECT printf('%.5f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id)) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom
WHERE element IN ('p','br')
AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id FROM (
  SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
  FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
  UNION
  SELECT c.atom_id2
  FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
) c

SELECT a.element
